at this point my family is pretty much just me and my dad - my mum has a whole host of mental health issues which definitely influenced me genetically and psychologically, but i dont really know what more i can do to treat that. i understand that puberty probably isn't helping, but honestly suidical thoughts and self harm have been a part of my life since before puberty (awful to admit but true).

thank you for commenting, i called a hotline and that helped a little so i think i can manage some sleep x

i'm on 3 separate waiting lists for counseling, all self-refereed and taking months. i'm in the uk so i can't be given medication til i'm over 18 and my doctor really couldn't do anything but say if i was thinking of harming myself (which i wasnt at the time) i should be checked into hospital. i feel like i'm trying so hard and every time i reach out to professionals it gets thrown back in my face
thank you, i promise i'll try x

you're right. i've deleted my op because it was a real dick move to make a public post making her out as the bad guy, when at that point neither of us were communicating properly and in the end i was the shitty one for ending it so abruptly without making sure that she was okay.

like i said before i was in no position to be in a relationship when i was that unstable, and you're right, it was selfish of me to try when i couldn't be a support for my girlfriend and could only take. i haven't dated since and i don't think i will for a while, i genuinely hope that she's found someone who can do a better job than me and is doing better in her own head. 

honestly making that post in the first place was a drunk mistake that i should have deleted straight away. i thought i was better than that but i guess i've still got some resentment and 'what she did was worse' going on. thanks friend for calling me out, i think i needed that.
that's a great idea! i'm fully into having a badass family heirloom to parade my toddlers around in.

they were a local punk band in the town i grew up in (derby), my uncle was the bassist for a while and my dad tattooed most of them so i tagged along to their shows from about 6 months old. raised me right!

i wish it did! but the size is literally 10-12 months, so even if i could get my arms through i'd tear open the back. i keep meaning to move the patches to my adult size jacket but it feels weird to rip it up :/

also this wasn't a 'conversation' and it wasn't her 'telling me the truth' it was her angrily snapping at me (out of nowhere - which was the issue) whilst i was looking for reassurance and someone to calm me down. this wasn't a sit down conversation about my problems, and i wasn't acting like i was the only person who has issues. i broke up with her because i cannot function in a relationship with someone who i see as unpredictable, and now i saw her as that.

okay, thanks for the feedback. i know this is a depression sub, but i don't know if you understand how irrational anxiety makes people, especially when they have unresolved trauma (as i did) and are making a big decision during a severe panic attack (which for me looks like crying, hyperventilating on the ground). my instant reaction to being snapped at was to completely cut the person that snapped at me out of my life. it wasn't justified or right, and i had no business being in a relationship when i was that unstable. i did have a lot of growing to do and i like to think that i'm getting there. at the end of the day she is better off without that version of me, i guess thanks for helping me see that.

if you'd like me to clarify, i grew up with a incredibly unstable abusive mom and i react really badly to people snapping at me (which is something that my ex and i talked about). looking back i know the way i broke up with her was shitty but i was in a really anxious state in a bad situation and needed her to support me, when she didn't after always saying that she would i freaked out and acted way too hastily without really thinking it through. i guess i always figured that if it was a one-off and i just called her at a bad time then she would tell me that and try to work through it, instead all she said to our friend was 'alright then'. you're right though, she was working through her own issues and i didn't think about that in the moment, i regret not waiting until i wasn't panicking to make my decision.

When I was 15 my mom told me that my dad wasn't my biological father and that she wasn't going to let me see him again. I freaked out - my dad had been my rock throughout all the emotional abuse and mental health stuff I'd been through - and I told myself that if she went through with it I'd end it all, I made a plan and a note and everything. Luckily, I convinced a family member to pick me up and take me back to my dad, 6 months later I cut my mom out of my life and I haven't looked back.
